hooks.command: input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$file" == *.tex ]]; then dir=$(dirname "$file"); base=$(basename "$file"); cd "$dir" && echo "--- pdflatex: $base ---" && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode "$base" 2>&1 | grep -E '(^!|Citation.*undefined|Reference.*undefined|Error)' || true; fi
